user.title: Brewfather Integration Setup
user.description: Enter your Brewfather account credentials to connect the integration. Make sure your API key has the correct scopes.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this Brewfather connection in Home Assistant
data_description.password: Your API key from Brewfather Settings > API

features.title: Choose Features
features.description: Select which Brewfather features you want to enable in Home Assistant.

data.custom_stream_enabled: Enable custom stream for temperature monitoring

data_description.ramp_temp_correction: Automatically adjust target temperatures during fermentation steps with ramping schedules
data_description.multi_batch: Monitor and display data from multiple fermenting batches simultaneously
data_description.all_batch_info_sensor: Create an additional sensor containing detailed information about all batches
data_description.custom_stream_enabled: Automatically send temperature readings from Home Assistant to Brewfather

custom_stream.title: Custom Stream Configuration
custom_stream.description: Configure Brewfather Custom Stream fermentation telemetry. Brewfather accepts at most one log entry per device name every 15 minutes.

data.custom_stream_logging_id: Brewfather Logging ID or Stream URL

data_description.custom_stream_logging_id: Enter your logging ID or paste the complete stream URL from Brewfather
data_description.custom_stream_temperature_entity_name: Primary beer temperature. For GF30 use the RAPT Pill or another deliberately chosen beer-temperature source.
data_description.custom_stream_gravity_entity_name: Current SG, for example from a RAPT Pill.
data_description.custom_stream_device_name: Unique Brewfather device name. Brewfather rate-limits each name independently.
data_description.custom_stream_aux_temperature_entity_nam: Brewfather displays aux_temp as Fridge Temp. Use only for a source that is semantically appropriate, such as coolant temperature.
data_description.custom_stream_ext_temperature_entity_nam: Brewfather displays ext_temp as Room Temp. Leave blank unless the source really represents ambient/room temperature.
data_description.custom_stream_temp_target_entity_name: Current fermentation temperature target, for example from BrewAssistant.
data_description.custom_stream_gravity_target_entity_name: Target SG / expected FG. Sent as Brewfather gravity_target.
data_description.custom_stream_device_source: Description of the physical/logical data source, for example BrewAssistant GF30.
data_description.custom_stream_report_source: System forwarding the values to Brewfather, for example Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Brewfather API
error.invalid_scope: The API-Key doesn't have the correct scopes.
error.invalid_api_key: Unable to authenticate with given credentials.
error.unknown: Something went wrong, please check the log files.
error.invalid_entity: Selected entity is not valid or unavailable
error.unsupported_temperature_unit: Temperature sensor must use Celsius (°C), Fahrenheit (°F), or Kelvin (K)
error.custom_stream_test_failed: Connection test failed, please verify your settings

abort.already_configured: This Brewfather account is already configured
